hypothesis: Replace explicit cursor induction with indexed entry access so MWCC synthesizes and coalesces the induction pointer; express the allow_hidden condition as a boolean value so its compiler temporary precedes the induction pointer in allocation.
notes: All source variants were compiled independently with the existing Ninja canonical GC/1.3 command. Only the best source remains.
Declaration-order swaps used the indexed loop as their common baseline, unlike earlier explicit-cursor attempts.
Narrowed count/index types were diagnostics only and are rejected because they restrict the original int range.
Two first shared-local probes failed C89 declaration ordering; their corrected probes also regressed.
Raw canonical and strict final objdiff outputs are recorded separately.
